Subject: Elm Street compliance kickoff: Type II report, bridge letter & secure intake

Hi Sarah — great demo earlier, thanks for the time. Quick written recap and proposed next steps so we’re aligned on asks from your procurement/security team: 

1) SOC 2 Type II report: please let us know whether you need a redacted report or a temporary attestation first (we can do a provisional attestation while we coordinate the Type II handoff).
2) Bridge letter: we can share a standard bridge letter; I’m attaching a draft for your review (Vanessa will confirm content).
3) Trust portal access: we can provision read-only access to our evidence portal (time-limited) for your security reviewers.
4) Vendor questionnaire: if you have a vendor security questionnaire (VSQ/DDQ) we’ll start populating it; alternatively we can share our completed standard questionnaire.

Ask: Can you confirm the list of items you need (report vs attestation), whether Elm Street requires HIPAA-specific language, and the main security reviewer email? If you want, I can schedule a short intake call this week for the onboarding steps.

Attachments: (referenced) — we’ll attach a bridge letter draft and the VSQ template in the next email.

Thanks,

From: Sarah Klein <sarah.klein@elmstreethealth.com>
To: Rohan Mehta <rohan_mehta@redwood.com>
Cc: security@elmstreethealth.com
Date: Tue, 7 Jul 2026 10:03:45 -0700
Subject: Re: Elm Street compliance kickoff: Type II report, bridge letter & secure intake

Thanks Rohan — useful recap. A couple clarifying points from our side before we proceed: 

- Scope: Elm Street needs confirmation that the SOC 2 covers the Redwood hosted API and inference runtime (not just internal dev tools). Can Vanessa confirm scope coverage?
- HIPAA/GDPR: We operate in the US but are subject to HIPAA. We need either a Type II report that references HIPAA controls or a bridge letter with HIPAA-specific attestation language.
- Evidence access: For procurement, we prefer time-limited portal access over emailed PDFs. If you can grant access for 7 days that would be ideal.
- Logs/Retention: We need confirmation that access logs and audit trails are retained for at least 12 months.

If possible, please start with a provisional attestation/temporary letter while the Type II transfer is arranged — we can put a 1-week window on the portal access for our security team to review. Our security contact is security@elmstreethealth.com (they’ll coordinate access).

Appreciate it — happy to jump on a quick 20-minute call if that helps.

Best,
Sarah Klein
Head of Procurement | Elm Street Health
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Klein <sarah.klein@elmstreethealth.com>, Rohan Mehta <rohan_mehta@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Jul 2026 11:20:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Elm Street compliance kickoff: Type II report, bridge letter & secure intake

Hi Sarah — Vanessa from Redwood Security here. Thanks for the clear list — answers below and next steps.

Scope confirmation:
- The Type II report we maintain covers production inference endpoints and the Redwood API used by customers in hosted and dedicated modes. I’ll include a short scope statement when we hand over the report so it’s explicit that inference/serving runtime is included.

HIPAA/GDPR:
- We do not produce a HIPAA-specific report, but we can include HIPAA-relevant controls in a bridge letter/attestation. If you need us to reference specific HIPAA controls, send the required language and we’ll incorporate it into the bridge letter.

Evidence portal & retention:
- We can provision a time-limited, read-only link to our Trust Portal for reviewers. Proposed default: 7 days access.
- Audit logs and access trails are retained for 12 months (logs are stored centrally; we can provide a snapshots/summary on request).

Timeline & artifacts we can share now:
- Draft bridge letter (attached): redwood_bridge_letter_draft.pdf
- Vendor security questionnaire (XLSX): vendor_security_questionnaire.xlsx
- Trust Portal invite (one-time): https://trust.redwood.com/portal/elmstreet/INVITE/abc123 (will expire once accepted)
- Redacted Type II report: available for secure download once NDA/portal access is confirmed; expect placement in portal within 3 business days after we receive confirmation from Elm Street.

Next steps (suggested):
1) Sarah/security@elmstreethealth.com confirms they want temporary attestation + portal access for 7 days.
2) Elm Street signs the portal access terms (we’ll send a short form) and confirms the reviewers list.
3) We provision the portal invite and upload a redacted Type II report within 3 business days; bridge letter will be available immediately.
4) Elm Street completes the attached VSQ; we’ll mark answers and follow up on any gaps.

I’ve attached the bridge letter draft and the VSQ template for your review. If the language looks OK, Rohan — can you confirm the contact(s) we should provision and I’ll send the portal invite today.

Regards,
Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Security & Trust | Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
